unit.why: A quoted instruction from Sefer Noam Elimelekh / Shvil Emunah that studying five pages of Gemara with the Rosh, as R. Elimelekh commanded, is worth more than fasting. It is a teaching with no narrated event, followed by a section heading («מענין תפוחים»).
